posts.author: Scion_of_the_Shadowlight
posts.body: I don't know if it is built in the game, I didn't see it, but I know RPG Maker FES had this, basically it was something to make an event or character partially see through, like a ghost, any idea how I might achieve this?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Use the set moveroute command and change opacity to whatever you like. Otherwise just edit your spritesheet.
